body:
So I snorted about 300-500mg's (can't remember exactly) at about 10:00pm.
T+0:10: I was in a trance by this time.
T+0:30 By now I was no longer able to switch songs on my ipod--I felt a bit of nausea, but nothing too drastic.
T+0:45: This wasn't a trip anymore: I felt like I was dying. Unable to move, only able to think. I felt like everything in the world wasn't a test: I felt like this is the only world that we get a shot at.
T+0:55: I had puked twice already, in my bed, because I was unable to move.
T+12:00: I still feel the effects: unable to concentrate and more.
